title: Transfer without a receiving hand
body: The kit is sealed. The clipboard says transfer complete, but the receiving signature is a blank line. Someone has written a small shoe beside the bed number.
rival_reading: An exposure could interrupt a transfer and leave a medical kit with incomplete paperwork; the missing signature does not show that officials hid a containment failure.
gloss: A completed medical transfer has a sealed kit but no receiving signature.

title: Field supplies without a source
body: The bandage wrapper is marked for a field patient. The bottle has no name, only a time and a green line. The transfer sheet says hold until cleared; a nurse has written, ‘Mother waiting,’ on the back.
rival_reading: A rushed response could hold a patient’s supplies while staff managed a movement restriction; the anonymous bottle does not establish a farm program malfunction.
gloss: Field medical supplies carry a time and a personal note while their source remains absent.
